summary: Discover all air-search radars on a side, blink them on/off (EMCON) with a duty-cycle floor, enforce datalink sharing, and expose the sensor picture to other addons (alive-drones, ew-zones, ATAK suite, ALiVE rewrite).

phases.name: Engine validation
phases.goal: Resolve engine unknowns before trusting any design. Each item is a ~10 minute editor experiment.

items.test: setVehicleRadar enum values for forced-on / forced-off

items.method: diag_log the array in a live mission

items.test: Will a radarless launcher FIRE on a datalink-only track (not just display it)?
items.method: Encore S-750 radar/launcher pair vs target drone; if no fire, try confirmSensorTarget; if that fails, rework Phase 3

items.test: Do passive sensors (IR/visual) keep working while radar is forced off?
items.method: Force radar off, fly IR-hot target past, watch sensor display
items.note: Decides whether a dark SAM is blind or just silent — shapes the whole system feel. Test first.

phases.name: Core EMCON
phases.goal: Radar discovery + blink scheduler + duty-cycle floor.

decisions.question: What counts as a managed radar?
options: ground vehicles + statics only (exclude anything that flies)
decisions.recommendation: Ground + statics only; aircraft manage their own emissions and the blink loop should not fight the AI pilot

decisions.question: Rescan cadence for radars spawned mid-mission (e.g. by ALiVE)
Duty-cycle floor scope
decisions.recommendation: Global for launch; per-cluster deferred to Phase 5 refinement

phases.name: Datalink layer
phases.goal: Enforce reportRemoteTargets / receiveRemoteTargets / reportOwnPosition on the right vehicles.

decisions.question: Datalink enforcement scope
options: every vehicle on the side (full 2040 picture, touches vehicles other mods may manage)
decisions.recommendation: Radars-only default; side-wide as a module toggle

decisions.question: How to identify radarless launchers that should receive the picture
options: second config sweep: air-target missiles present but no ActiveRadarSensorComponent
decisions.recommendation: Config sweep, with classlist variable as override — matches module-variables-everything rule

phases.name: Pop-up ambush mode
phases.goal: Launcher dark -> datalink track enters envelope -> radar on -> engage -> dark after shot or timeout.

decisions.question: Where does the engagement envelope number come from?
options: read missile range from config (accurate, more work)
decisions.recommendation: Module variable with sane default — doubles as a difficulty knob

phases.name: Reveal bridge + integration
phases.goal: IADS becomes the sensor backbone of the Modern Warfare family.

integrations.use: AA-drone dispatch consumes IADS tracks instead of running its own detection loop — one detection economy, two responders (mirrors recon-feeds-EW-dispatch unification)
reportOwnPosition feed becomes the BFT layer
OPCOM replacement gets a real air picture to reason about

decisions.question: Who receives reveals (perf policy)?
options: registered consumer groups (AA units, drone controllers, OPCOM)
decisions.recommendation: Registered consumers — requires a small subscribe hook in the other addons

phases.name: Refinements (deferred)
items: Counter-DE / hardening flavor if ever wanted

variables.name: blinkIntervalMax
variables.note: each radar re-rolls its own jittered timer; no learnable metronome

variables.name: exemptClasslist
variables.note: pinned always-on; same pattern as ew-zones radio exempt list

variables.name: ambushMode
variables.note: Phase 3 toggle, lives on the controller rather than its own module

variables.name: debugMarkers
variables.note: marker per radar, green = emitting, grey = dark, tracks vehicle, cleans up on death — alive-drones convention

modules.name: Reveal Bridge
modules.placement: separate module (useful without EMCON; other addons consume it independently)

first_decision.question: Should a blinked-off radar still contribute passive detections to the datalink (dark-but-watching) or be fully blind (dark-and-blind)?
first_decision.note: If passive sensors survive force-off natively (P0-4), dark-but-watching comes free; if not, do NOT fake it
